template.title: The Silent Day of Charades
template.summary: When a child can't speak, they use drawings and gestures to share breakfast and have a fun family dinner.

sentences.text_with_blanks: The child woke up and tried to say hello, but only a squeak came out.
They went to the kitchen and wanted [[slot_food]], but the grown‑up gave them a banana instead.
The child made a big hand‑shake and [[slot_gesture]] to show they wanted the food, but the grown‑up thought they were asking for a [[slot_misunderstanding]].
After a few more silly gestures, the child realized they could act it out like a game of charades.
They flapped their arms like a bird to ask for chicken nuggets, and everyone laughed.
The family, [[slot_family]], joined in and started making pictures and gestures for the whole day.
At dinner, they all used only hands to order, and the child got the chicken nuggets they wanted.
Everyone cheered, and the child felt happy that they could share without words.
